decisive_findings.cause: WorkerResultV1 trusts touched_paths as the complete write declaration. An owned source artifact can be removed from touched_paths and still validate when an overlapping read_path covers it, so a changed owned artifact can be relabeled as read-only evidence.

Path authorization accepts exact-case strings separately while duplicate detection compares raw path strings. On the current case-insensitive host, validator/src/orchestration/worker.rs and validator/src/orchestration/WORKER.rs resolve to the same inode and can both enter one result.
The positive broad-frozen test still parses NODE-005 and asserts 28 artifacts, so it does not prove the exact NODE-006 29-artifact submission it claims to freeze.

rejected_root_changes.reason: The request is stale and NODE-006 is not independently accepted. Root wiring remains unapplied.

corrective_scope: Add explicit typed provenance that distinguishes changed/write artifacts from frozen read-only evidence; do not infer writes solely from worker prose. Every changed artifact must remain touched and owned, while read-only evidence must be exact-current and covered by the current lease read set.

Reject case-fold, Unicode-normalization, hardlink, symlink, and filesystem-identity aliases before result commitment. Duplicate detection must use a stable canonical identity appropriate to the validated host boundary, not only raw strings.

Preserve host-protected denial, traversal and ancestor rejection, generated-output and fixture touched requirements, exact digest commitments, requested-root-change binding, replay identity, and no-event-on-rejection behavior.

Replace the stale NODE-005 positive fixture with the exact NODE-006 parent result and assert 29 artifacts, while retaining a separate historical NODE-005 regression only if it has a distinct honest name.
Run focused and full N10 tests with cargo-nextest at 16 jobs in an isolated target directory, then return a new exact WorkerResult-v1. Request but never apply root-owned module wiring.
claim_ceiling: N10 remains an unaccepted internal orchestration candidate. Root module wiring, production execution adapter, persisted recovery journey, node closure, readiness, release, and completion remain withheld.
no_claim_statement: This decision does not claim N10 completion, readiness, release, or goal completion.
